title: Quasicrystalline Gibbs Phases in Higher Dimensions
exact_target: In each dimension at least three, can a translation-invariant equilibrium state be a mixture containing nonperiodic pure phases?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002740 (OWR-13355-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: Dynamical versus Diffraction Spectra in the Theory of Quasicrystals (2014), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2014/53, pp. 2987--3013. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 9, 10.
Taati and Miękisz, finite-range quasicrystalline Gibbs states (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The quantifier over dimensions and the distinction between a translation-invariant mixture and its nonperiodic extremal components are part of the target. The state space and meaning of short range remain source-specific.
